Photo sources for scanner tests:

- `potato-diamant.jpg` and `potato-diamant-side.jpg`: two source photos from [Multi-view RGB image dataset of four potato varieties](https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/rgn2d2jb7f/1), CC BY 4.0. Used as model-wiring fixtures, not independent accuracy evidence.
- `not-potato-orange.jpg`: photo by [projectart69 on Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/projectart69/8662529759/), [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/). Distributed in [COCO 2017 validation](https://cocodataset.org/#download) as image `000000290081.jpg`; no changes to the photo.
